item.title: Kansas man charged in unprovoked park stabbing that left woman critically injured
item.summary: A Kansas man faces attempted murder charges after allegedly stabbing a woman in what police called an unprovoked park attack in Olathe, Kansas.

item.title: 'The View' argues whether Iran campaign is historic blunder like Iraq or will keep future Americans safe
item.summary: CNBC's Sara Eisen argued on "The View" that Trump's Iran military operation will keep future Americans safe from a nuclear threat, but co-hosts pushed back.

item.title: Rep Boebert rejects call for another $200 billion to fund Iran war, while Americans 'can’t afford to live'
item.summary: Rep. Boebert warned the policies being enacted by the Trump administration are not putting Americans first, warning the GOP needs to change course before the midterms.

item.title: Unauthorized drones detected over US Air Force base housing nuclear-capable B-52 bombers: military
item.summary: Barksdale Air Force Base, which houses nuclear-capable B-52 bombers, detected unauthorized drones amid heightened U.S. Air Force security as the war in Iran continues.

item.title: Live possum discovered hiding among plush toys in an Australian airport gift shop
item.summary: A wild possum found a clever hiding spot among plush toys in an airport gift shop in Australia and was safely removed, staff confirmed.

item.title: NYC Mayor Mamdani’s wife glorified terrorists in online posts, criticized US military: report
item.summary: New York City first lady Rama Duwaji is facing backlash amid resurfaced posts that show her praising airplane hijackers and using racial slurs.

item.title: FBI warns Russian hackers targeting Americans on Signal; thousands of accounts compromised
item.summary: The FBI warned that Russian intelligence-linked hackers are targeting Signal users, including U.S. officials and journalists, compromising thousands of accounts.

item.title: Boxer Tyson Fury's dad, John Fury, reveals their relationship 'is destroyed'
item.summary: John Fury said his relationship with his son, boxer Tyson Fury, was “destroyed," citing decisions on Oleksandr Usyk fights. He also criticized trainer SugarHill Steward.

item.title: Federal judge rules Pentagon policy restricting press access unconstitutional, hands victory to New York Times
item.summary: The New York Times is touting a victory after a federal judge ruled in its favor in a lawsuit against the Pentagon claiming its press policy violated the First and Fifth Amendments.

item.title: Chicago's teetering debt is stark warning left-wing mayor is fueling 'pay later' doom cycle: expert
item.summary: Expert Austin Berg warns Chicago's "pay later" debt culture under Mayor Brandon Johnson is alarming markets with a $1 billion budget gap and risky bond deals.
